support.note: The sourced resource multiplier and five-second Core cloak are exercised through Headless, Viewer and RL at L7-L9; L10 is catalogue-only pending the frozen historical compatibility contract, and combat geometry remains partial.

known_uncertainties: The exact current L10 numeric values are only a version-unknown secondary observation; the official April note confirms availability but publishes no numbers, requirements or build identifier.

The frozen historical Core regression fixes the materialized maximum at L9. L10 remains a hash-pinned normalized catalogue observation only, and is deliberately unavailable through Core, Headless, Viewer, RL, snapshots and replays pending an explicit compatibility revision.

No consulted source defines Cloak detection at its expiry boundary, existing projectile, splash, trap, defensive-troop, target-loss, collision, route, line-of-sight or simultaneous-target ordering; Core's integer tick and entity-ID ties are an explicit deterministic baseline, not a game-exact claim.
No source-verified current L10 visual tier was obtained; the Viewer remains on its documented public asset route without visual-fidelity claim.
conclusion: Sneaky Goblin L7-L9 has a shared Core baseline and L10 is preserved as hash-pinned catalogue-only evidence. The official five-second defense cloak and resource ×2 multiplier remain materialized only where the frozen compatibility contract permits.
